values.title: Roast goose, char siu & crispy pork
values.summary: 29 Dec: Chung Wah goose dinner. 1 Jan: Ki’son for remaining pork tastings; share small rice combinations.
values.body:
29 Dec, 19:00–20:30: Chung Wah Roast Goose / 中華燒鵝傳承, G/F 497A Nathan Road, near Yau Ma Tei Exit C. A relaxed dinner after Lantau. Roast goose is the priority: start with rice meals for two, share, and add char siu or crispy pork only if good value. The three tastings may happen at different meals. Allow HK$160–200 total for two as a planning estimate, not a menu quotation. A third-party guide reports an approximately HK$80 solo goose-and-crispy-pork set; its current contents and price remain unverified. Published regular hours are 10:00–22:00 daily; that does not guarantee goose stock at 19:00. Check current prices, evening stock / fresh-batch timing and whether reservation or preorder is useful before travel.

Walk: from Exit C allow 3–5 minutes, HK$0. From Bridal Tea House, 6 Arthur Street, the mapped walk via Arthur Street and Man Ming Lane is about 170 m / 2 minutes; allow 3–5 minutes, HK$0, and the same for the return. If goose is unavailable, Ki’son at 546 Nathan Road, Shops B–C, G/F, Mong Kok Building, near Exit A2 is about 230 m / 4 minutes from Chung Wah; allow 5–8 minutes with crossings, HK$0. Use it only if open and stocked.

1 Jan, 19:00–21:00: keep the Mong Kok food crawl. Ki’son Roasted Goose / 棋子燒鵝, G/F 34 Mong Kok Road near Mong Kok Exit B3, is a suggested stop for remaining meats. Ideally share one char siu + crispy pork combination rice; HK$70–90 total is an estimate for one tasting plate for two, not two full meals. If all three meats were tasted on 29 Dec, this stop is optional. The 546 Nathan Road branch is an alternative, not another required visit. Ask whether sharing is accepted; takeaway can suit a shared plate.

Order 半肥瘦叉燒: half-fat, half-lean char siu, sweet barbecued pork. 燒肉 / 燒腩仔 is crispy roast pork belly. Tick goose, char siu and crispy pork independently after tasting. Keep no beef / no beef broth, including any complimentary or optional soup; confirm ingredients or skip soup.

Foodpanda Mong Kok online base prices checked 1 Nov 2026, before promotions: goose rice from HK$70; two-meat rice from HK$70; goose plus one other meat rice from HK$75. Supplements may apply. These are not verified dine-in prices or prices for the Yau Ma Tei branch. Mong Kok’s published regular 10:00–22:00 daily hours do not confirm New Year’s Day opening or meat stock. The hotel → Ki’son Mong Kok walk is about 1.3 km / 19 minutes mapped; allow 20–25 minutes and leave after the 18:45 hotel rest. Snacks can start en route; keep the existing 21:00–21:25 hotel return.

25 Dec stays flexible: nearby roast meats are only an optional early opportunity after Aqua Luna if open and stocked; late-evening goose is not the main plan. No extra compulsory visit. Dinner / tasting allowances replace or form part of existing meal spending; do not count another dinner.
